value.rationale: The standard ten-vertex cubic GP pair has identical binary-majority recurrent counts, so it supplies a natural controlled contrast for the effect of a third opinion. The exact full-census discovery is not just an isolated count: the graph with more two-cycle attractors has roughly half as much oscillatory basin volume, and 360 extra equilibria arise solely from truly three-color states. The specific finite invariant is motivated by deterministic plurality with unbiased incumbent ties and tests attractor-count versus basin-volume distinctions important in finite network dynamics.
